quote.body: In the past, our ad data, private-message conversations, and order data were isolated fragments. We had no way to know which video a customer chatting on WhatsApp had clicked to come in. Cluega IM completely broke open that black box. Now, we only need customer service to simply click “Payment completed,” or let AI identify it automatically, and we can know the true return on ad spend.

utmTracking.title: Social UTM tracking, with every traffic source traceable.

chatMessages: I would like a quote for 5,000 units of Specification A, delivered in batches next quarter. What are the FOB price and lead time for the first batch? Please have a manager follow up.
Received! This fits our enterprise tiered pricing. I have booked our Key Account Director for a call tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Does that work for you?

Yes. But this shipment is going to the Middle East, and Specification A's 180°C heat resistance is not enough. Do you have hardness and tensile strength reports? We cannot purchase if it does not meet the standard.

Understood! The full SGS test report has been sent to your email (tensile strength 450 MPa). For extreme heat-resistance needs, we recommend Specification A-Plus (in stock, heat resistance up to 220°C). Would you like details?
A-Plus is more suitable. If we switch to 5,000 units, does your main warehouse have enough stock? The first 2,000 units must be container-loaded and shipped early next month, so the deadline is firm.
Our main warehouse has 800 units in stock, and another 1,500 units will come off QC the afternoon after tomorrow, for a total of 2,300 units. That fully covers your first shipment of 2,000 units.
That is cutting it close. Has this running production capacity been reserved by another customer? I do not want the order intercepted right before loading.

Please rest assured. This batch was originally quoted to a European customer, but since no deposit was paid, the system has placed a temporary Allocation Lock for you. Once the contract is signed tomorrow, it becomes your dedicated inventory.
Good. What about rolling production for the remaining 3,000 units? Can your lines absorb it? We cannot have supply gaps.

No problem. We coordinate production across multiple bases with monthly capacity of 50,000 units. The remaining 3,000 units will enter a rolling production plan, with 1,000 units of overseas-warehouse safety stock locked each month. The Director will provide the full assurance agreement tomorrow.
Very thoughtful. Since A-Plus upgrades the specification, please ask the Director to offer more discount tomorrow.
Understood. Tomorrow we will seek the best first-order commercial discount for you (Introductory Offer). The A-Plus quotation has been updated in your backend. See you tomorrow at 10:00!
See you tomorrow, and have a pleasant day!
